verdict.rationale: Cake's own help centre documents a first-party Cake MCP that lets Claude, Codex, Cursor or any MCP client connect and query the live cap table (shareholders, option pool headroom, vesting, share classes, SAFEs and notes). The scope is read-only. Missing for 10: documented setup/auth and endpoint details, write/action tools beyond read-only queries, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Connect Claude, Codex, Cursor or any MCP client to Cake and ask about your Cap Table in plain English.
Ask your AI assistant about shareholders, option pool headroom, vesting, share classes, SAFEs and notes - answered from your live Cap Table in Cake. All read-only.
